bullets: Put yourself in someone else's hands to achieve great things.
Embrace challenges, such as painful sharpening, for growth.
Learn from mistakes and correct them.
Value the qualities that make you unique and different.
Leave a positive mark on the world through your actions and contributions.
Believe in yourself and your abilities.
Take risks and step out of your comfort zone.
Be open to new experiences and learning opportunities.
Cultivate a growth mindset and be willing to learn from others.
